snippet.title: The Dark Queen of Mortholme | Steam Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Indie game developer/publisher Monster Theater is proud to partner with acclaimed independent game developer Mosu on 'The Dark Queen of Mortholme' to bring the viral indie hit to Steam. 

The Dark Queen of Mortholme comes to Steam August 15th, 2025. 

Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3587610/The_Dark_Queen_of_Mortholme/

In this short-form indie, you are the final boss, unrivaled in power. A hero invades—easily crushed. Yet, they keep returning. 

Please wishlist this 30-minute short-form indie game about an unusual bond, perspectives, and the beauty of change.
